title: Software Developer (Web Application)
bulletPoints: Built Patroli, a progressive web app for security guard patrols: guards scan a QR code at each checkpoint, and supervisors follow each round on a live dashboard.
Worked directly with the business owner on requirements, then took Patroli from screen design to deployment with Preact, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL) and Netlify.
